howItWorks.title: Three steps to your people
howItWorks.step1Desc: Tell the Agent <highlight>what you want to do</highlight> and <highlight>who you're looking for</highlight>, just like chatting with a friend.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The Agent grasps your <highlight>real needs</highlight> and <highlight>preferences</highlight>, not just surface-level info.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Get precise recommendations of <highlight>people or events</highlight> that fit, with conversation starters ready.
